belief: Fear of hell is the main reason to follow God.
meta: A Christian look at the false belief that fear of hell is the main reason to follow God, with Scripture, questions, and homework for replacing it with the truth.
origins: Coming to faith mainly through frightening sermons about hell. Teaching that used fear to motivate obedience. Following God out of fear without ever experiencing His love. Seeing God mainly as a judge to avoid. Worry that without fear, you would stop obeying.
teaches: Scripture is honest about judgment, and a healthy reverence for God is good. But the main reason to follow God is His love. There is no fear in love; perfect love drives out fear. We love because He first loved us. It is God’s kindness that leads us to repentance. Christ’s love compels us. You did not receive a spirit of slavery that leads to fear, but the Spirit of sonship, by whom we cry, “Abba! Father!”
self_statements: I follow God so I don’t go to hell.
If I weren’t afraid, I’d stop obeying.
God is mainly someone to avoid angering.
Love is nice, but fear is what keeps me in line.
I don’t really enjoy God; I just fear Him.
Fear is the only thing that works for me.
errors: Focusing on judgment while overlooking God’s love.
Believing fear is the strongest motivator for obedience.
Seeing God as a harsh authority figure.
Thinking that without fear, you would have no reason to follow God.
questions: What does perfect love do with fear, according to 1 John 4:18?
Why do we love God, according to 1 John 4:19?
What leads us to repentance, according to Romans 2:4?
What kind of spirit did I receive: slavery to fear or sonship?
Is my obedience coming from love or from fear?
What would following God out of love look like for me?
Have I experienced God’s love, or only heard about His judgment?
truth: Fear of hell is not the main reason to follow God. I follow Him because He first loved me. His kindness leads me to repentance, and His love compels me. I am not a slave living in fear but a child crying, “Abba! Father!” Perfect love drives out fear.
hw_questions: What does perfect love do with fear?
Did I receive a spirit of slavery or sonship?
Is my obedience from love or fear?
hw_truths: I love God because He first loved me.
God’s kindness leads me to repentance.
I am God’s child, not a slave to fear.
I can obey God out of love and joy.
log: Each day, write one way God showed His love to me and one way I responded out of love.
name_example: For Sarah did not receive a spirit of slavery that returns her to fear, but she received the Spirit of sonship, by whom she cries, ‘Abba! Father!’

and write how the father’s love differs from fear-based religion.

prayer: Father, thank You for loving me first. Help me reject the lie that fear of hell is the main reason to follow You. Let Your perfect love drive out my fear, and let me follow You as Your beloved child, compelled by the love of Christ. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
